scope: All 20 authored subtitle cues of the DIAC3 opening conversation inside Diaz's mansion. The later outdoor conversation and robot-control scene are outside this test.
translation_status: Reviewed clean Russian adaptation for original synthetic stand-in voices, not an official localization.
spoken_text_rule: Use each ru value verbatim through its catalogue_line_id; do not synthesize source English or rewrite at runtime.
timing_rule: start_ms and end_ms are unmodified retail subtitle cues. Speech timing fit must be measured; these times do not assert successful lip sync or in-game playback.
speaker_reference_scope: Used only to corroborate speaker identities. Dialogue text and timing come from the supplied DIAC3.CUT bytes, not these web transcriptions.
